ui.description: Set your defaults and establish your portfolio. Stock data and AI can be configured later without blocking entry.
ui.calloutDescription: Unconfigured external services limit only their related capabilities, and their status is always shown clearly.

activeStep.preferencesDescription: Your language and theme are saved to the system and stay consistent across browsers.

activeStep.portfolioDescription: Create the single portfolio first; stocks and holdings can be added whenever you are ready.
activeStep.stockDescription: FTShare is an optional stock data source; verify its connection later from Settings.
activeStep.inferenceDescription: Choose a provider and model for each capability; network outages never block saving.

fields.portfolioHint: Stocks and holdings can be added later from their dedicated pages.

stock.title: Stock data provider

stock.keyHint: Leave blank to configure later; network outages never block saving.

inference.title: AI provider and models
inference.description: Optional. Chat and Embedding can use different providers and models.
inference.hint: Save the provider and models, then verify each connection separately in Settings.
